gen.rule.station.platform_length.title: Platform length
gen.rule.station.platform_length.desc: Length of the platform: the longest train that stops plus a stopping margin; design choice, the operator's train length decides it.
gen.rule.station.platform_width.title: Island platform width
gen.rule.station.platform_width.desc: Width of an island platform between its two edges; it holds the escalator, stair and lift wells with a walking lane each side; design choice.
gen.rule.station.edge_lane.title: Edge lane
gen.rule.station.edge_lane.desc: Clear walking lane kept between a well and the platform edge, and between wells along the platform; design choice.
gen.rule.station.trackway_width.title: Trackway width
gen.rule.station.trackway_width.desc: From the platform edge to the inside face of the box wall: the vehicle with its clearance and an escape walkway; design choice.
gen.rule.station.rail_depth.title: Rail depth
gen.rule.station.rail_depth.desc: Depth of the top of rail below the ground; the line's alignment decides it.
gen.rule.station.platform_height.title: Platform height
gen.rule.station.platform_height.desc: Platform floor above the top of rail, level with the train floor; design choice.
gen.rule.station.track_bed.title: Track bed
gen.rule.station.track_bed.desc: From the top of rail down to the top of the base slab: rails, sleepers and the track slab; design choice.
gen.rule.station.cover.title: Soil cover
gen.rule.station.cover.desc: Soil over the roof slab: room for street services, paving and planting; design choice.
gen.rule.station.roof_slab.title: Roof slab
gen.rule.station.roof_slab.desc: Thickness of the roof slab carrying the soil cover and the street; design choice before the structural design.
gen.rule.station.base_slab.title: Base slab
gen.rule.station.base_slab.desc: Thickness of the base slab under the tracks, which also holds the box down against ground water; design choice.
gen.rule.station.floor_slab.title: Floor slab
gen.rule.station.floor_slab.desc: Thickness of the concourse and platform slabs; design choice.
gen.rule.station.concourse_height.title: Concourse height
gen.rule.station.concourse_height.desc: From the concourse floor to the underside of the roof slab: headroom, signs and the services above the ceiling; design choice.
gen.rule.station.platform_clear.title: Clear height over the platform
gen.rule.station.platform_clear.desc: Least clear height from the platform to the underside of the concourse slab; design choice.
gen.rule.station.end_zone.title: End zone
gen.rule.station.end_zone.desc: Length of the plant zone at each end of the box beyond the platform: fans, substation, pumps; design choice.
gen.rule.station.dwall_min.title: Least diaphragm wall
gen.rule.station.dwall_min.desc: Thinnest diaphragm wall, the smallest common grab width; design choice.
gen.rule.station.dwall_per_depth.title: Wall per depth
gen.rule.station.dwall_per_depth.desc: Diaphragm wall thickness per metre of excavation depth; a first sizing before the geotechnical design.
gen.rule.station.dwall_step.title: Size step
gen.rule.station.dwall_step.desc: Steps the wall thickness and the shaft sizes are rounded up to; design choice.
gen.rule.station.dwall_toe.title: Wall toe
gen.rule.station.dwall_toe.desc: Embedment of the diaphragm wall below the formation, as a share of the excavation depth; a first sizing before the geotechnical design.
gen.rule.station.peak_flow.title: Peak flow
gen.rule.station.peak_flow.desc: People per hour that leave the platform in the peak; the ridership forecast decides it.
gen.rule.station.escalator_capacity.desc: Practical capacity of one escalator; design choice for a one-metre step band.
gen.rule.station.escalator_banks.title: Escalator banks
gen.rule.station.escalator_banks.desc: Banks of escalators between the platform and the concourse, spread along the platform; design choice.
gen.rule.station.escalator_standby.title: Standby escalators
gen.rule.station.escalator_standby.desc: Escalators in each bank beyond the peak flow, so one can stop for repair; design choice.
gen.rule.station.escalator_angle.title: Escalator angle
gen.rule.station.escalator_angle.desc: Slope of the escalators; design choice, the common incline.
gen.rule.station.escalator_width.title: Escalator width
gen.rule.station.escalator_width.desc: Width an escalator takes in its well, balustrades included; design choice.
gen.rule.station.escalator_landing.title: Escalator landing
gen.rule.station.escalator_landing.desc: Flat length at each end of an escalator well: the landing and the machine pit; design choice.
gen.rule.station.stair_width.title: Stair width
gen.rule.station.stair_width.desc: Width of the fixed stair beside each bank of escalators; design choice, the exit width a country pack asks for replaces it.
gen.rule.station.stair_riser.title: Stair riser
gen.rule.station.stair_riser.desc: Highest riser of the station stairs; design choice for heavy public use.
gen.rule.station.stair_waist.title: Stair waist
gen.rule.station.stair_waist.desc: Thickness of the stair flight slab; design choice.
gen.rule.station.stair_flow.title: Stair flow
gen.rule.station.stair_flow.desc: People a metre of stair width carries up per minute in an evacuation; design choice.
gen.rule.station.train_load.title: Train load
gen.rule.station.train_load.desc: People one full train brings to the platform; the rolling stock decides it.
gen.rule.station.evac_time.title: Evacuation time
gen.rule.station.evac_time.desc: Longest time to clear two full trains off the platform; design choice, a country pack's evacuation time replaces it.
gen.rule.station.psd.title: Platform screen doors
gen.rule.station.psd.desc: 1 fits platform screen doors along both platform edges.
gen.rule.station.psd_height.title: Screen height
gen.rule.station.psd_height.desc: Height of the platform screen above the platform.
gen.rule.station.psd_door_width.title: Screen door width
gen.rule.station.psd_door_width.desc: Clear width of a platform screen door.
gen.rule.station.train_door_pitch.title: Train door pitch
gen.rule.station.train_door_pitch.desc: Distance between train doors; one screen door per pitch of platform.
gen.rule.station.lifts.title: Lifts
gen.rule.station.lifts.desc: Lifts from the platform to the street, for step-free access; design choice.
gen.rule.station.lift_shaft.title: Lift shaft
gen.rule.station.lift_shaft.desc: Side of a lift shaft; design choice for a stretcher-sized car.
gen.rule.station.vent_flow.title: Ventilation flow
gen.rule.station.vent_flow.desc: Air the tunnel ventilation moves through each end of the station; design choice before the ventilation study.
gen.rule.station.vent_velocity.title: Shaft air speed
gen.rule.station.vent_velocity.desc: Air speed in a ventilation shaft; design choice that keeps noise and pressure loss low.
gen.rule.station.column_spacing.title: Column spacing
gen.rule.station.column_spacing.desc: Longest distance between the columns on the platform centreline; design choice.
gen.rule.station.column_size.title: Column size
gen.rule.station.column_size.desc: Side of a square station column; design choice before the structural design.
gen.why.e.station_box: box {l} x {w} m inside the walls: platform {pl} m and two end zones of {ez} m; platform {pw} m wide between two trackways of {tw} m
gen.why.e.station_levels: rail {rail} m below ground: platform level at {pz} m, concourse at {cz} m, base slab top at {bz} m
gen.why.e.station_clear: {h} m clear over the platform under the concourse slab, at least {min} m
gen.why.e.station_dwall: diaphragm walls {t} m thick down to {bot} m: excavation {exc} m and a toe of {toe} m below it
gen.why.e.station_escalators: {n} escalators in {banks} bank(s): peak {flow} people/h over {cap} per escalator, {sb} standby per bank
gen.why.e.station_well: escalator well {len} x {wid} m: rise {rise} m at {angle} degrees plus landings of {land} m
gen.why.e.station_stairs: {n} fixed stair(s) {w} m wide beside the escalators, each well {len} m long
gen.why.e.station_lifts: {n} lift shaft(s) of {s} x {s} m from the platform to the street
gen.why.e.station_psd: {n} platform screen doors on each platform edge, {w} m wide every {pitch} m, screen {h} m high
gen.why.e.station_vent: {n} ventilation shaft(s) of {s} x {s} m: {flow} m3/s at {v} m/s per end
gen.why.e.station_columns: {n} column(s) of {c} m along the centreline, at most {sp} m apart, none in a well
gen.why.e.station_evac: platform cleared in {t} min: {people} people over {cap} per minute up the escalators and stairs, at most {lim} min
gen.rule.station.stair_gap.title: Stair flight gap
gen.rule.station.stair_gap.desc: Gap between the two flights of a station stair turning on its landing; design choice.
gen.rule.station.lift_load.title: Lift load
gen.rule.station.lift_load.desc: Rated load of a station lift; the car is the library type of that load, a stretcher fits from 1000 kg.
gen.rule.station.vault_rise.title: Vault rise
gen.rule.station.vault_rise.desc: Rise of each tunnel barrel vault over the span it covers; design choice, the crown stays under the concourse slab.
gen.rule.station.vault_bay.title: Vault segment length
gen.rule.station.vault_bay.desc: Longest length of one vault segment along the tracks; design choice, one segment per structural bay.
gen.rule.station.ground_margin.title: Ground margin
gen.rule.station.ground_margin.desc: How far the ground plane reaches beyond the box walls; design choice.
gen.why.e.station_vaults: {n} barrel vault segments of {bay} m over the trackways and the platform, rise {k} of the span, crown under the concourse slab
gen.why.e.station_ground: ground plane in four strips round the box walls, {m} m beyond them; the box is a hole, no earth over it
gen.rule.station.vault_spring.title: Vault springing
gen.rule.station.vault_spring.desc: Lowest springing of a tunnel vault above the platform; design choice, the clear height of a person plus the screen doors.
